## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Static-only checklist

- [ ] This change does not add APK, DEX, native library, decompilation, emulator, installation, or runtime testing steps.
- [ ] This change does not claim runtime verification, safety, or compatibility.
- [ ] No third-party code is included without a compatible license and attribution.
- [ ] No secret, token, private key, APK, or personal data is included.
- [ ] Generated files (`patches-list.json`, `patches-bundle.json`, `PATCHES.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) are untouched.
- [ ] Documentation states the limitations of the change.
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`python -m pytest`, `patchguard validate`).
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) and use semantic messages.

## Evidence

Paste test output, schema validation output, or documentation links. Do not paste secrets or large third-party code excerpts.

## Related issues

Link related issues or discussions.
